title: release-train-weekly-prep-notes-leah-park-2026-03-04
content:
Release Train Weekly — Launch Readiness (prep notes)
Date: 2026-03-04
Owner: Leah Park (eng-release)
Goal: Quick sync to verify go/no-go criteria for v2.3 rollout next Tue 2026-03-10. Capture owners, open items, and immediate follow-ups.

Attendees (planned): Marcos (QA), Priya (SRE), Evan (Product), Aisha (PS), Camille (Docs optional)

High-level summary (TL;DR):
- Most infra + canary plumbing green, small QA regression in reranking flow causing latency spike on long prompts (Marcos).
- Monitoring dashboards largely ready; alert thresholds TBD by Priya.
- Release packaging docs incomplete (Aisha to finish).

Go/No-Go checklist (quick status) — must be explicit owners + status
1) Feature completeness: all release-ticketed items merged to release branch (owner: Evan) — STATUS: mostly done, 3 small PRs in review (Evan)
2) QA signoff: critical E2E tests passing in staging (owner: Marcos) — STATUS: failing flaky test in reranking-case (see below)
3) Infra readiness: autoscale + capacity tests passed, no region constraints (owner: Priya) — STATUS: passed in us-west/us-east, pending eu-west smoke (Priya)
4) Observability: dashboards for latency/cost, SLOs instrumented, alerts configured (owner: Priya) — STATUS: dashboards ready, alert thresholds to confirm
5) Canary plan: traffic split, monitoring window, rollback criteria (owner: Leah) — STATUS: draft plan, need explicit rollback runbook
6) Rollback plan / DB migrations: no destructive migrations; migration tested (owner: eng-release infra) — STATUS: OK
7) Legal / compliance checks (owner: Aisha) — STATUS: docs pending but no blockers identified
8) Docs & runbooks: customer-facing changelog + internal runbook (owner: Aisha + Camille) — STATUS: changelog draft, runbook missing runbook section for KV cache reset

Known blockers / details:
- Reranking latency regression on long prompts (Marcos): reproduces in staging when sequence length > 3k tokens after rerank step. Root cause suspiciously related to KV cache eviction + quantized kernel path; Marcos to triage with serving-runtime team (PR opened: github.com/redwood-inference/serving-runtime/pull/1187). Impact: increases tail latency for ~2% of sessions.
- EU region smoke tests pending (Priya): capacity in eu-west limited this week due to instance maintenance; expected clear by Mon 2026-03-08.
- Alert threshold for token-cost-per-request needs signoff from finance to avoid noisy alerts (owner: Leah + Finance).

Open action items (owner -> task -> due):
- Marcos Diaz -> isolate rerank regression (run bisect, compare quantized vs fp kernels) -> due: 2026-03-05
- Priya Kapoor -> finish eu-west smoke + confirm autoscale behavior under burst -> due: 2026-03-06
- Evan Ramirez -> merge remaining 3 PRs or attach feature flags for quick disable -> due: 2026-03-05
- Leah Park -> finalize canary plan doc + publish rollback runbook snippet -> due: 2026-03-05
- Aisha Rahman -> complete release packaging doc & internal runbook sections (incl. KV cache reset steps) -> due: 2026-03-05
- Finance (point: Nora Kim) -> confirm cost-alert thresholds for token-cost-per-request -> due: 2026-03-06 (Leah to ping)

Pre-release checklist (to check during go/no-go review):
- [ ] All P0/P1 tickets closed or gated behind feature flag
- [ ] Staging E2E green for last 48h
- [ ] Canary plan doc published and shared in #release-train Slack
- [ ] Rollback verified on staging (dry-run)
- [ ] Monitoring alert runbook linked in the release ticket
- [ ] Customer changelog drafted and reviewed by PMs
- [ ] Post-mortem owner assigned for major incidents

Risk assessment (quick):
- High: reranking latency regression — could affect SLAs for chat-heavy customers (impact small subset but high severity). Mitigation: gate rerank behind FF if not resolved before canary, extend canary window, tighten rollback triggers.
- Medium: eu-west capacity — schedule delayed rollouts by region if capacity not restored.
- Low: docs completeness — operational risk but not user-facing immediately.

Meeting notes / decisions (to record during sync):
- If Marcos cannot resolve rerank regression by 2026-03-05 EOD, we will disable rerank for canary traffic (decision: Evan + Leah)
- Priya to sign off on eu-west by Mon 03-08; if not green, postpone eu rollout to next week and continue hosted/hybrid regions
- Finance to provide soft thresholds; use conservative alerts for first 72h of canary

Parking lot / follow-ups (non-blocking):
- Post-release: schedule perf deep-dive for reranker + quantization interaction (owners: serving-runtime, applied-ml)
- Longer-term: add synthetic traffic test for long-prompt rerank scenario to CI (owner: Marcos)

Quick links / references:
- Confluence plan: CONFLUENCE-PLANS-3892
- Release ticket: JIRA-RT-2412
- PR (rerank kernels): github.com/redwood-inference/serving-runtime/pull/1187

Next sync: 2026-03-05 09:30 PT (quick stand) — objective: final go/no-go decisions, confirm action item progress.

Notes to self (Leah):
- Ping Nora (Finance) in morning; add alert thresholds to release ticket.
- Prepare canary Slack message template with rollback steps so we can paste during rollouts.
- If rerank FF is added, ensure automated FF toggle is documented in runbook.

---
Informal scratchpad below (useful snippets to copy into release ticket):
- "If rerank latency > 500ms p99 for canary window, auto-roll back after 30m"
- "Canary split: 1% -> 5% -> 20% over 6 hours if no alerts"
- "Rollback command: infra deploy rollback --tag v2.3-canary --confirm"

(End of prep notes)
